what_changed: CFPB withdraws its Regulation AA proposal on prohibited contract terms (12 CFR 1027) as of May 15, 2025.
compliant_agent_must_now: No change to current obligations: the proposed contract-term prohibitions and codification of Credit Practices Rule provisions will not be adopted by the CFPB.
rationale: Withdrawal of a proposal triaged relevant at low confidence (2025-00633); relevance follows that proposal. Stage A: title, abstract and metadata only; full text not read.
